# Superseded Phase 6 implementation artefacts

The report and `derive.py` in this directory are reconstructed implementation artefacts, not exact original clean-room files. They are retained to preserve history and are superseded by the [original Phase 6 archive](../phase6/README.md).

`MANIFEST.txt` and the two spec-deletion records preserve bundle preparation evidence. The tarball and comparison-side expectations are not committed. Consult the original archive for the verbatim report and script.
